what: Five section names with a top border line stand at five spots on the four screen edges (top center · left center -90° · bottom left 180° · bottom right 180° · right center -270°). Each time a section crosses screen center, the names rotate one slot around the border in a .55s keyframe. Going down: top → left (via the corner) → bottom left → bottom right → right → top (via the corner), and going up the reverse. So the current section’s name always stands at top center. At 1023px or below, the top spot moves to the top right.

options.sections: Section picker css, default section — in this order they become sections 0,1,2… Name k stands at position k in section 0, so on entering section i, name (5 − i) % 5 comes to the top center
options.dur: Time for one step to turn (seconds), default 0.55 · 0 moves into place instantly
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Section name slots (up to five, positions 0~4 in order of appearance). The a inside is a block
options.--fx-side: Amount the left and right slots overhang past the edge, default -1rem (phone -1.3rem)

use:
News
Contact
Access

note: The name is attached to the four edges of the window with position: fixed. Even in an inner scroll panel (data-fx-scroller), section changes follow that panel, but the position is relative to the window. The color follows the text color (currentColor), so to turn it white over a photo, the user only changes color. Because the original numbers are kept as they are, left→bottom-left (f1) and bottom-left→left (b2) jump once since the first frame sat somewhere different, and b2 ends half a line higher. Jumping to a non-adjacent section in one go (anchor move) sends the names back to their first positions — original behavior. Each time the section changes, fx:change (detail.index) is sent to the element

from.where: index.html .ry-nav — for each of five sections (hero+news · booking · about · directions · contact) five section names run around the border. Per-section @keyframes moveNavi… 0.55s forwards from the original element.css (no curve specified = ease) on the body class section<n>tosection<m> The value measured exactly as applied
